_comment: REV B - H1 REVISION 2026-07-28. P2 MERGED constraints for lumina-strobe (LUM-DTR-STROBE-A), from research/power.json + drive-stage.json + energy-store.json + protection-sense.json + led-emitter.json + refdesign-pulsed-led-driver.json, reconciled with architecture/sheets.md rev B. D-04 CLOSED AS RGBW (requirements s10.1) and the board is 802.3af-ONLY (s10.3). CANONICAL net names per sheets.md s1: power symbols are global and BARE (GND, +48V_SW, +12V, +3V3); root-crossed signals are /NAME; sheet-internal signals are /<sheet>/NAME, and there are now FOUR drive sheets (drive_w, drive_r, drive_g, drive_b) so the single /drive/LED_K of rev A becomes four colour-qualified nets. SIX MERGE DECISIONS. (1) research/power.json's /LED_A is DELETED, not renamed: nothing sits between the bank positive terminal and harness pin 1, so it was an alias of /VBANK, and a declared voltage net that is absent from the netlist makes check_creepage hard-error. (2) the four /drive_*/ISNS nets carry the 2.6 A declaration but are deliberately ABSENT from voltages: each is a 0-0.52 V node, so check_creepage treats it as 0 V and demands the full 48 V clearance from its matching LED_K across the pass FET, which is correct. (3) power[] currents are reconciled to the FINAL operating point of power_tree.md, not to research/power.json: +48V_SW is 1.0 A (the carrier eFuse fault ceiling on the stub UPSTREAM of the daughter's own 0.20 A limiter), not 0.6 A. (4) REV B: /VBANK is 10.4 A, not 2.6 A - four colours at 2.6 A can fire together. IPC width for that on 1 oz external is ~7.6 mm, so /VBANK MUST BE POURED from the bank terminals to J200 and must never be left to the router as a trace; see power_tree.md s11. (5) REV B: thermal[] powers are 0.81 W per pass FET and 0.82 W for the charge FET - the SUSTAINED 25 Hz case at the 44.5 V normal ceiling with one colour alone, which is the binding operating case. The armed 48 V case is 1.41 W and does NOT pass the gate at any copper area; it is a momentary blast mode bounded by firmware and by a 60-120 s thermal time constant, NOT an operating mode, and declaring it here would fail P8 on a condition the board is not designed to sustain. This choice is stated openly in power_tree.md s5.1. (6) REV B: min_vias 12 on every power FET is load-bearing, not decorative - check_thermal clamps a_eff at 645 mm2 summed over ALL layers within a 14.3 mm disc, so theta_JA cannot go below 51.1 C/W, and reaching even that needs >= 350 mm2 on F.Cu PLUS >= 350 mm2 mirrored on B.Cu tied by those vias. Rev A's 900-1200 mm2 F.Cu pour figures were derived from the uncapped curve and score nothing extra; see blocks.md s6.1. dt_c is 69 = Tj_design 125 C minus the 56 C af internal air of ICD s7.6 - NOT the corpus default of 40. ICD s7.6 IS PROVISIONAL: the par run calculates 89-115 C independently (requirements s10.6), at which two of these five thermal rows fail on average power; the mitigation is a governor cap of P_rail <= 7.9 W at 85 C air / <= 6.9 W at 90 C air, costing 4-16 % of the light and zero parts. That sensitivity is derived in power_tree.md s10 and reported at H2; it is deliberately NOT merged into the dt_c here, because s7.6 is still the ICD of record and this run does not get to re-issue it. TWO MANDATORY P5 STEPS, both with exact recipes in architecture/stackup.md s7. (a) placement.keepouts BELOW ARE IN THE ICD FRAME (board top-left = origin). board_init does NOT place the outline at (0,0) - the origin comes from the packed component bbox - so after board_init, read reports/board_init.json.outline_bbox = [ex1,ey1,ex2,ey2] and ADD (ex1,ey1) to every rect. They are declared rather than omitted because an absent keepout lets a part land in the RJ45 notch or the antenna column. NOTE that --cutout does NOT need this rebasing: it is outline-relative. (b) planes ship WITHOUT regions and MUST be given the three-rectangle-per-layer regions of stackup.md s7 so the antenna column (88,25)-(100,55) carries NO plane copper on either inner layer; a full-board pour there detunes the carrier's ESP32-S3 antenna 11 mm below. THE RJ45 NOTCH IS NO LONGER A GAP: board_init.py --cutout 6,0,30,26 exists and is verified present in the script (requirements s10.5); the keepout below is retained anyway so the board is electrically correct either way. ONE P5/P7 TRAP carried from the carrier: rules_gen never reads the voltages key, so nothing makes the P7 router honour the ICD rev A2 0.635 mm 48 V clearance - add the hand-written .kicad_dru rule of stackup.md s2.1, keyed on A.NetName (A.Net silently matches nothing), and note it must now cover FOUR drain nets which also need 0.635 mm FROM EACH OTHER. check_creepage demands only 0.60 mm, so a 0.635 mm layout passes P8 by construction but is NOT enforced by it. GND is deliberately NOT a power entry: it is a plane, and declaring it would make check_current demand IPC width on every GND stub; the requirement is structural instead (solid In1 + In2 GND, 12 connector pins for the return).
